After the leasing period, if your income rises above 32000 a year you’d be asked to move into the normal studio (which is the same size and specs as the bond program one). We cooould afford to live in the normal apartments comfortably but it would take longer to pay off our debts. AITA?

That's a significant saving. We asked about availability, and they said there are a lot of apartments available right now, so it's not like people are scrambling to get in. After the leasing period, if our income rises above $32,000 a year, we'd be asked to move into the normal studio apartment, which is the same size and specs as the bond program one. We could afford to live in the normal apartments comfortably, but it would take longer to pay off our debts. So, is it right or wrong to keep our income low to apply for this program? I'm not sure.
